items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I had this picture made in 1945, I was with Jim Atchene Orchestra.

ctx.x: Up in Memphis, he used to go up there and play for the cotton festival or whatever they call it.
I had this picture made in 1945, I was with Jim Atchene Orchestra. Oh yeah. Jim Atchene.
It's up in Kansas City. That's right. Did you work up there then?
